tools.name: get_me
tools.description: Get the current user, workspace, plan and remaining credits.

tools.name: archive_gamma
tools.description: Archive a Gamma. Archives a Gamma document. The operation is idempotent - archiving an already archived Gamma succeeds.

gammaId.description: The unique ID of the Gamma to archive

tools.name: archive_image
tools.description: Archive a media item. Removes an item you created (such as a generated image) from the workspace media library. The operation is idempotent - archiving an already archived item succeeds. The underlying file is not deleted: existing URLs continue to work.

savedMediaId.description: The media library identifier of the item to archive, as returned in `image.savedMediaId` by the image generation status endpoint

tools.name: create_agent_generation
tools.description: Create agent generation. Creates an asynchronous generation job run by the Gamma agent. `prompt` is the only required field. Guidance fields (`numCards`, `additionalInstructions`) are soft targets; `numCards` must not exceed the card maximum for the workspace plan. To work from your own files, such as a presentation to import, store each with `POST /v1.0/uploads` and list them in `files`. A `folderId` or `sharingOptions` setting that a workspace admin restricts is ignored and reported in `warnings`. Returns a `gen_`-prefixed generation ID to poll with `GET /v1.0/agent/generations/{generationId}`.

themeId.description: Optional saved theme to apply, using an `id` from `GET /v1.0/themes`. The theme is applied on Gamma's Standard Brand Base design for the requested `format`. Cannot be combined with `templateId`: a template or gamma keeps its own look.

numCards.description:
Target number of cards, capped at the plan's maximum (10 on free plans,
100 on paid plans); a higher value is rejected with 400. Within the cap
it is a soft target: the agent may deviate by a card or two, and the
result is not validated against it.

sourceUrls.description: Up to 10 http or https URLs the agent reads as source material. A link the prompt depends on, such as a Google Slides deck to import or a report to build the deck from, is required: when it cannot be read, the agent creates no gamma and the generation fails with an explanation. A link given only as background is skipped when it cannot be read.

files.description: Files stored with `POST /v1.0/uploads`, as the `{ uploadId, filename }` that route returned. The agent works from them beside the prompt; a .pptx or .pdf is imported with its own layout. Add `purpose: 'import'` to import that file faithfully as the new presentation; at most one file can have it. At most 50 files and 250 MiB in total. Each upload can be attached to one generation; to retry, upload the file again.

purpose.description: Omit to give the agent the file as ordinary source material.

prompt.description: The brief: what to generate. The only required field.

title.description:
Title for the generated Gamma.
When set, it is the Gamma's saved title, whatever heading the agent writes.
When omitted, the title is derived from the content.

folderId.description:
Folder to place the generated Gamma in, within the caller's workspace.
Use an `id` from `GET /v1.0/folders`.

sharingOptions.description: Access settings for the generated Gamma.

workspaceAccess.description: Default access level for workspace members

externalAccess.description: Access level for external users (via shared link)

format.description:
Output format. Defaults to "presentation" when omitted. `webpage` is
not supported by the agent engine and is rejected.

templateId.description:
Optional starting point: the id of an accessible workspace template, of
a regular gamma in the workspace, or of an official
Gamma template (the `exploreTemplates[].id` returned by
`GET /v1.0/templates/search`). The selection works the way picking the
same template or gamma in the Gamma app does: the prompt decides how the
source is used, from filling its layouts with new content to borrowing
only its look or moving its content onto a new design, and the source
itself stays unchanged. An official template id names the currently
published copy: it survives routine
updates but can change when Gamma rebuilds or reintroduces the template,
so rediscover it through the search endpoint if a saved id stops being
accepted. Unknown, unauthorized, other-workspace, archived and retired
ids are all rejected with the same 400; no other template is substituted
for a rejected id.

quality.description:
Quality preset: "lite", "standard", or "max" — the same presets the
Gamma app offers. `max` requires a plan that includes it and can use more
credits. Omitting the field uses the API default, capped at what the
plan includes.

additionalInstructions.description:
Guidance: extra direction for the generation (tone, audience,
language, style). Treated as guidance the agent aims to follow, not
a constraint the output is validated against.

exportAs.description:
Export the finished gamma after a successful generation as a PDF, PPTX,
or PNG zip. Export failure is reported as a warning on the generation,
never as a failed generation.

disableConnectors.description: Opt this run out of workspace connector access (e.g. Notion, Slack).

tools.name: create_from_template_generation
tools.description: Create generation from template. Creates an asynchronous generation job from a template Gamma with variable substitution.

exportAs.description: Export format for automatic export after generation

prompt.description: Text prompt describing what to generate

title.description: Custom title for the generated Gamma. If not provided, a title will be automatically generated from the content.

gammaId.description: The File ID of the gamma to be used as a template. The File must contain exactly one Page.

themeId.description: Theme ID to apply to the generated Gamma

allOf.description: AI model to use for image generation

workspaceAccess.description: Default access level for workspace members

externalAccess.description: Access level for external users (via shared link)

folderId.description: Folder to place the generated Gamma in.

folderIds.description:
Folder to place the generated Gamma in. Accepts at most 1 folder ID.
Ignored when folderId is provided.

tools.name: create_generation
tools.description: Create async generation. Creates an asynchronous generation job. Provide either `inputText` for a single-page File, or a `pages` array to generate a multi-page File (optionally published as a Gamma site via `publish`). Returns a generation ID that can be used to poll for status.

textMode.description: How to interpret the input text

pages.description: Generate multiple pages in a single File. When provided, takes precedence over the top-level per-page fields (`inputText`, `textMode`, `numCards`, `format`, `additionalInstructions`, `cardSplit`, `textOptions`, `imageOptions`). File-level options (theme, sharing, folders, card dimensions, export, publish) still apply to all pages. Up to 50 pages per request.

textMode.description: How to interpret this page's input text

cardSplit.description: How to split content across cards for this page

title.description:
Custom title for this page. If not provided, a title will be
automatically generated from the content.

inputText.description: The text content to generate from (topic, outline, or full content)

additionalInstructions.description: Additional instructions for the AI for this page

numCards.description: Target number of cards for this page

path.description:
URL slug for this page within the published site. When omitted,
Gamma derives a slug from the generated title and disambiguates
collisions. Honored for additional pages (pages 2..N); the first
page is the File's main page and its path is implicit.

textOptions.description: Text generation options for this page

amount.description: Controls the amount of text generated per card

language.description: Language code for the generated content

tone.description: The tone or writing style for the generated text

audience.description: The target audience for the content

imageOptions.description: Image generation and selection options for this page

model.description: AI model to use for image generation

allOf.description: AI model to use for image generation

source.description: Source for images: AI-generated or web search

format.description: Output format for the generated Gamma

cardSplit.description: How to split content across cards

exportAs.description: Export format for automatic export after generation

inputText.description: The text content to generate from (topic, outline, or full content)

title.description: Custom title for the generated Gamma. If not provided, a title will be automatically generated from the content.

publish.description:
If true, publishes the generated File as a Gamma site after all
pages succeed. Applies to multi-page (`pages`) requests.

numCards.description: Target number of cards/slides to generate

amount.description: Controls the amount of text generated per card

language.description: Language code for the generated content

tone.description: The tone or writing style for the generated text

audience.description: The target audience for the content

model.description: AI model to use for image generation

allOf.description: AI model to use for image generation

source.description: Source for images: AI-generated or web search

hideFromFirstCard.description: Hide header/footer from the first card (title card)

hideFromLastCard.description: Hide header/footer from the last card

workspaceAccess.description: Default access level for workspace members

externalAccess.description: Access level for external users (via shared link)

folderId.description: Folder to place the generated Gamma in.

folderIds.description:
Folder to place the generated Gamma in. Accepts at most 1 folder ID.

tools.name: create_image_generation
tools.description: Create async image generation. Creates an asynchronous image generation job that produces one standalone on-brand image. Returns an image generation ID that can be used to poll for status. If `themeId` is provided but does not exist or is not accessible to your workspace, the request fails with 400.

type.description:
Visual style of the generated images. Defaults to "illustration".
Skipped when referenceImages are present — references take precedence
and style comes from the prompt.

sizePreset.description:
Output size preset (sets the aspect ratio; exact pixel dimensions are
model-determined). Defaults to "social-square" (1:1).

referenceImages.description:
Reference images with subject semantics ("put this character or product
in the scene"), each either a `url` or an upload's `uploadId` and
`filename`. Maximum 4. When present, they take precedence over `type` and
`themeId`.

url.description:
HTTPS URL of the reference image. The server fetches, validates, and
rehosts the image before generation.

role.description:
How the reference influences generation. `subject` places the pictured
character or product into the generated scene.

uploadId.description:
Id returned by `POST /v1.0/uploads`, for an image uploaded by the same
user and workspace: JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, or AVIF, at most 20 MB and 25
megapixels (all frames together for an animated image). An upload that no
agent generation attached expires two days after it was created.

prompt.description:
Description of the image to generate. Background treatments ("on white",
"contained in a circle") go here.

themeId.description:
Theme to brand the images with. Defaults to the workspace default theme.
Applied for all types except `"scene"`, whose curated style ignores theme
colors (a `theme_ignored_for_type` warning is returned if you supply
`themeId` for `scene`). Also ignored when referenceImages are present —
references drive the look.

tools.name: create_upload
tools.description: Upload a file. Stores one file for `files` on `POST /v1.0/agent/generations`. Send the raw bytes as `application/octet-stream` with a `Content-Length` header; chunked and content-encoded bodies are rejected. Files can be up to 250 MiB, and images up to 50 megapixels. Each upload can be attached to one generation. An upload that is never attached expires two days after it was created.

mimeType.description: The file's media type. It must match the file's contents.

tools.name: delete_gamma
tools.description: Delete a Gamma. Deletes a Gamma document. Requires workspace admin role on the workspace the API key belongs to. The Gamma is auto-archived first if not already archived, so a single call handles the full archive-then-delete transition. The Gamma becomes immediately inaccessible and is removed from all workspace views. After deletion, the Gamma is no longer addressable via the API; subsequent requests for the same ID return the same response as for a non-existent Gamma.

gammaId.description: The unique ID of the Gamma to delete

tools.name: edit_gamma
tools.description: Edit an existing Gamma. Creates an asynchronous AI edit of an existing Gamma from a natural-language `prompt`. The edit changes the target page unless the prompt names another page of the Gamma, and it can add, duplicate, reorder, rename, and archive pages when the prompt asks for it. It never archives the target page. Returns an edit ID to poll with `GET /v1.0/agent/edits/{editId}`. Requires at least edit permission on the Gamma. Only one edit runs on a Gamma at a time.

gammaId.description:
The Gamma to edit: a gamma (file) ID, or a page ID (the id in a
gamma.app/docs/<id> URL). The ID sets the edit's target page: a file ID
targets the Gamma's main page, a page ID that page. A prompt that names no
page edits the target page; one that names another page of the Gamma, by
title or position, edits that page.

quality.description:
How much model effort the edit runs with, matching the quality tiers in the
Gamma agent UI. `max` requires a plan that includes it and can use more
credits. Omitting the field uses the API default, capped at what the
plan includes.

disableConnectors.description: Opt this edit out of workspace connector access (e.g. Notion, Slack).

tools.name: export_gamma
tools.description: Export an existing Gamma. Creates an asynchronous export job for an existing Gamma in the requested format. Returns an export ID to poll for the download URL.

gammaId.description: The ID of the Gamma to export — accepts a gamma (file) ID or a page/doc ID (the id in a gamma.app/docs/<id> URL).

exportAs.description: File format to export the Gamma to.

tools.name: get_agent_generation_status
tools.description: Get agent generation status. Retrieves the current status of an agent generation. Poll this endpoint until `status` is "completed" or "failed". The `gamma` object can appear on a pending generation once the document has been created.

generationId.description:
The generation id returned by `POST /v1.0/agent/generations`.
Agent generation ids are prefixed `gen_`.

tools.name: get_edit_status
tools.description: Get edit status. Retrieves the current status of an edit job. Poll this endpoint until `status` is "completed" or "failed".

tools.name: get_export_status
tools.description: Get export status. Retrieves the current status of an export job. Poll this endpoint until status is "completed" or "failed".

id.description: The unique export ID returned from the export endpoint

tools.name: get_gamma_analytics
tools.description: Get Gamma analytics. Returns doc-level engagement metrics for a Gamma: total views, unique viewers/editors, card count, last opened time, and a 30-day daily unique-viewer breakdown. Requires at least edit permission on the Gamma. When the API key's user has manage permission the metrics cover all viewers (`scope: "all"`); otherwise they cover only that user's own activity (`scope: "self"`). Data is eventually consistent (~hourly).

gammaId.description: The ID of the Gamma — accepts a gamma (file) ID or a page/doc ID (the ID in a gamma.app/docs/<id> URL).

tools.name: get_gamma_card_analytics
tools.description: Get per-card analytics. Returns per-card engagement data for a Gamma: view time (absolute seconds) and viewer reach (percentage) per card. Requires at least edit permission on the Gamma. When the API key's user has manage permission the data covers all viewers (`scope: "all"`); otherwise it covers only that user's own activity (`scope: "self"`). Data is eventually consistent (~hourly).

gammaId.description: The ID of the Gamma — accepts a gamma (file) ID or a page/doc ID (the ID in a gamma.app/docs/<id> URL).

tools.name: list_gamma_comments
tools.description: List comments on a Gamma. Returns comment threads on a Gamma, cursor-paginated. Supports an updatedSince filter for efficient delta polling.

gammaId.description: The ID of the Gamma to list comments for

limit.description: Maximum number of comments to return per page

after.description: Cursor for pagination (from previous response's nextCursor)

updatedSince.description:
ISO-8601 timestamp cursor. When provided, only comment threads with
activity (including new replies) after this timestamp are returned —
enabling efficient delta polling.

includeArchived.description:
When true, archived (deleted) comments and replies are included in the
response, each carrying an `archived` flag. Defaults to false.

tools.name: get_gamma_viewer_analytics
tools.description: Get per-viewer analytics. Returns paginated per-viewer engagement data for a Gamma. Requires at least edit permission on the Gamma. When the API key's user has manage permission the list covers all viewers (`scope: "all"`); otherwise it contains at most that user's own row (`scope: "self"`). Viewers are capped at 500. Data is eventually consistent (~hourly).

gammaId.description: The ID of the Gamma — accepts a gamma (file) ID or a page/doc ID (the ID in a gamma.app/docs/<id> URL).

limit.description: Maximum number of viewers to return

after.description: Cursor for pagination (from a previous response's nextCursor)

sortDirection.description: Sort direction, applied to the viewer's most recent open time

tools.name: get_gamma_viewer_detail_analytics
tools.description: Get single-viewer analytics. Returns one viewer's engagement with a Gamma: display name, email, last-opened time, cards viewed, and the relative time spent on each card (percentage of that viewer's total view time). Only authenticated viewers are addressable. Requires at least edit permission on the Gamma. When the API key's user has manage permission any viewer is addressable (`scope: "all"`); otherwise only the API key user's own activity is addressable (`scope: "self"`). Data is eventually consistent (~hourly).

gammaId.description: The ID of the Gamma — accepts a gamma (file) ID or a page/doc ID (the ID in a gamma.app/docs/<id> URL).

userId.description: The viewer's user ID — the viewerId returned by the viewers list endpoint for authenticated viewers.

tools.name: get_gamma
tools.description: Get gamma metadata. Returns metadata for a single gamma. Accepts either a file ID or the doc ID from a gamma.app/docs/... URL. Designed for link-preview integrations (Atlassian Smart Links, Notion Link Previews).

gammaId.description: The gamma file ID or the doc ID from the gamma.app/docs/... URL

tools.name: get_generation_status
tools.description: Get generation status. Retrieves the current status of a generation job. Poll this endpoint until status is "completed" or "failed".

id.description: The unique generation ID returned from the create endpoint

tools.name: get_image_generation_status
tools.description: Get image generation status. Retrieves the current status of an image generation job. Poll this endpoint until status is "completed" or "failed".

id.description: The unique image generation ID returned from the create endpoint

tools.name: list_folders
tools.description: List folders. Lists the folders the authenticated user can access within the workspace. Some may be view-only. Using a folder as folderId requires edit or full access.

query.description: Search query to filter folders by name

limit.description: Maximum number of folders to return

after.description: Cursor for pagination (from previous response's nextCursor)

tools.name: list_themes
tools.description: List themes. Lists all themes available to the workspace, including standard themes and custom workspace themes.

query.description: Search query to filter themes by name

limit.description: Maximum number of themes to return

after.description: Cursor for pagination (from previous response's nextCursor)

type.description: Filter by theme type: "standard" for built-in themes, "custom" for workspace-created themes. Must be kept consistent across paginated requests; changing it mid-pagination will yield inconsistent results.

tools.name: search_gammas
tools.description: Search gammas. Full-text search over the gammas the caller can access, matched against titles and body text. When a query is provided, results are relevance-ranked. When no query is provided (an empty query with at least one filter), results are ordered by last-updated descending.

q.description:
Full-text search query matched against gamma titles and body text.
Optional when at least one filter (createdBy, updatedAfter, updatedBefore)
is set.

createdBy.description:
Restrict results to gammas created by this user: 'me', an email address,
or a user ID.

updatedAfter.description: ISO-8601 lower bound (inclusive) on the gamma's last-updated time.

updatedBefore.description: ISO-8601 upper bound (inclusive) on the gamma's last-updated time.

includeArchived.description: When true, archived gammas are included in results. Defaults to false.

limit.description: Maximum number of hits to return (1-25)

tools.name: search_templates
tools.description: Search templates. Search the caller's workspace templates and the official Gamma explore templates. Returns two lists. With a query, workspace templates use best-effort relevance ranking against title and body text and may fall back to last-edited browse order, while explore templates use their best-effort ranking. An empty query returns both lists in browse order. Workspace browse results use last-edited order, most recent first. Workspace template IDs can be passed as the gammaId to generate-from-template, which validates eligibility at generation time and may reject some templates, such as multi-page or site-bound ones. Explore templates (the official Gamma templates) are not accepted as the gammaId for generate-from-template.

q.description: Search query. Workspace templates use best-effort relevance ranking against title and body text and may fall back to last-edited browse order. Explore templates use their ranked search. When omitted, both lists are a browse.

limit.description: Maximum number of hits to return per list (1-25)
